title: Reusable n8n CSV to MySQL Workflow
summary: Upload a CSV through a web form; mapped, validated rows land in MySQL and bad rows come back in a downloadable error log.
problem: Teams import CSVs by hand or with brittle scripts. One bad row breaks the whole load, and changing a column means editing code.
solution: An n8n workflow: Form Trigger upload, CSV parse, a single Settings node for table and column mapping (no code edits), a validator for required fields, integers, numbers, dates and emails, per-row MySQL inserts that catch database rejections, and a results page that returns error_log.csv. Tested end to end on n8n 2.45 and MySQL 8.4 in Docker.
outcomes: Bad rows skipped and logged, never block the run

title: Config-driven Strategy Backtester
summary: Turn trading rules into a TOML file and test them on historical stock or ETF data with realistic fills, costs and a full report.
problem: Traders want to test rules before going live, but spreadsheets hide look-ahead bias and ignore costs and slippage.
solution: A pandas engine that reads entries, exits, stops, targets and position sizing from one config file. Signals fill at the next bar's open, stops handle gaps, and commission and slippage apply on every fill. It outputs equity curve, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, profit factor, a trade log and a self-contained HTML report. Ten hand-checked tests run in CI on Windows and Linux.

title: AI Incident Command Center
summary: An Automation Anywhere APA solution that triages IT incidents with AI agents and keeps a human in the loop for risky decisions.
problem: Incident queues were triaged by hand: slow, inconsistent and hard to audit.
solution: A 43-node APA process orchestrates 2 AI Agents, 3 AI Skills and 13 TaskBots. Agents classify and enrich incidents, TaskBots execute approved actions, and human-review forms gate anything high risk. Shared exception paths and correlated audit logs make every run traceable.

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework
summary: A Node.js director that coordinates Claude, Codex and Gemini agents through research, design, build, review and verification stages.
problem: Single-agent coding runs lose context, skip review and are hard to resume.
solution: A central director assigns stages to specialist agents, keeps persistent shared context, asks for approval at gates, retries with limits and emits audit events to a monitoring dashboard. Runs can be paused and resumed.

title: ContextCompressor
summary: A TypeScript/Redis layer and proxy that trims LLM context and tool schemas to cut token spend.
problem: Long agent sessions and large tool schemas made every LLM call expensive and slow.
solution: Compresses conversation history and tool definitions under a token budget, keeps sessions in Redis, and exposes provider adapters for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini behind one proxy.

title: No-code AI Agent Builder
summary: A visual graph editor for building agents, workflows and chatbots without writing code.
problem: Business teams needed to prototype agents without waiting on developers.
solution: Drag-and-drop nodes (LLM, tool, condition, memory) on a canvas; the FastAPI backend executes the graph and streams results to the Next.js UI.

title: GST Invoice & E-Way Bill App
summary: A web app for Indian SMEs to raise GST invoices and generate E-Way Bills from one screen.
problem: Invoices and E-Way Bills were typed twice, in different systems, with frequent GSTIN errors.
solution: GSTIN lookup autofills party details, invoices compute tax automatically, E-Way Bills are created through the official API, and documents export to PDF.
outcomes: One entry for invoice and E-Way Bill

title: E-Way Bill RPA Bot
summary: A Python/Playwright bot that fills, cancels and downloads E-Way Bills on a government portal.
problem: Staff spent hours a day on repetitive portal data entry.
solution: Reads a spreadsheet of shipments, logs in with an operator-entered session, fills each form, saves the PDF, and writes a status report with screenshots on failure.

title: AI IT Ticket Triage
summary: LLM-based ticket classification with confidence thresholds and a manual-review fallback.
problem: Ticket routing was manual and mis-routed tickets bounced between teams.
solution: An LLM returns validated JSON (category, priority, team, confidence). High-confidence tickets route automatically; low-confidence ones go to a human queue. Every decision is logged.

title: Coding Agent VS Code Extension
summary: A sidebar coding assistant that uses tools and asks for approval before editing files or running commands.
problem: Developers wanted AI help inside the editor without giving it unchecked control.
solution: A webview chat calls an LLM with file, search and terminal tools; every edit or command is shown as a diff or preview and needs a click to approve.

title: Supply Chain Guardrail CLI
summary: A Go CLI that generates SBOMs and checks dependencies against OSV vulnerability data with policy rules.
problem: Teams shipped dependencies without knowing their vulnerability status.
solution: Scans a project, produces an SBOM, queries OSV for known vulnerabilities, and fails CI when policy rules (severity, licence, age) are broken.

title: Raspberry Pi + PiKVM + Tailscale Remote Ops
summary: BIOS-level remote control of PCs and servers plus a headless Pi app host, reachable securely from anywhere.
problem: Remote machines that hang or need BIOS access normally require someone on site, and port forwarding is risky.
solution: PiKVM on a Raspberry Pi 4 (HDMI capture + USB keyboard/mouse emulation) acts as a KVM-over-IP rescue console. A second Pi runs apps headless with systemd services and SSD boot. Both join a Tailscale tailnet, so there is no open port on the router.
outcomes: Reboot, BIOS and OS install remotely

title: News-aware Trading Automation Platform
summary: An automated intraday platform that combines market data and news signals with strict safety gates.
problem: Automated strategies can trade on stale or unreliable data.
solution: Pipelines ingest market data and news, score signals, and pass them through safety gates that halt trading when data is late or inconsistent. Runs headless on a Raspberry Pi with monitoring.
